audit.summary: Core proof-chain defects in covariance, approximation construction and rate balance; partial identities and bounded corrections verified.
limitations: P1 — False covariance lower bound on bounded convex support — Counterevidence: Full-support versions can require boundary conditions; weaker LemmaD6 survives this issue

P1 — False covariance lower bound on bounded convex support — Alternatives and counterevidence: The counterexample has nonzero boundary density, precisely the condition omitted by unqualified boundary-free Cramer-Rao reasoning. It refutes printed D.8 and the on-support extension, not a global-potential theorem with empty assumptions. Weaker D.6 avoids this lower bound.
P2 — Sharp cutoff approximation construction incompatible with continuity — Counterevidence: Enlarged support taper/endpoints plausible but requires new analysis

P2 — Sharp cutoff approximation construction incompatible with continuity — Alternatives and counterevidence: A correct cited approximation construction or enlarged-cube taper could supply a replacement, but is not the displayed sharp cutoff. Omitting a single endpoint is insufficient for continuous uniform approximation near a nonzero boundary. This is not an impossibility proof for an L2 approximation theorem.
P3 — Mesh exponent fails supplied improved-rate balance — Counterevidence: Smaller h=n^-5a lies within displayed big-O and repairs balance conditionally

P3 — Mesh exponent fails supplied improved-rate balance — Alternatives and counterevidence: h=O(n^-5a) lies in O(n^-4a), so an existential choice can satisfy the text. The insufficient condition alone does not specify that choice. A sharper gamma2 estimate or other discretization analysis might also repair the step, but none is established here.
